summary.text: Willy Chotzen is a Democratic state representative from Oregon House District 46 in Southeast Portland who has served since January 13, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former public school teacher and public defender, he serves as vice chair of the House Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Willy Chotzen was born in Ashland, Oregon, and earned a bachelor's degree from Washington University in St. Louis in 2013 and a law degree from Harvard Law School in 2019.
His career experience includes working as a public defender.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a father who has worked as a public school teacher and as a public defender.
Chotzen succeeded Khanh Pham in the Oregon House.
On his legislative website, he lists his committee assignments as Commerce and Consumer Protection, the Ways and Means Subcommittee on Public Safety, and vice chair of the House Judiciary Committee.
In the Ballotpedia survey, he named an economy centered on people, wage protections, and a high-quality free education among his key messages.
